Fraunces (by Un-Type / Alice Lee, Wei Huang, Kevin Chiu) and Manrope (by Mikhail Sharanda)
are both licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts (ofl/fraunces, ofl/manrope)
Full license text: https://scripts.sil.org/OFL

These files are static-weight, Latin-subset instances derived from the original variable
font sources for smaller download size — subsetting and weight-instancing are permitted
under the OFL. No font name was changed in a way that would require renaming under the
OFL's Reserved Font Name clause.

2026-07-18: added 4 more font-pairing options (Settings → font picker) —
Playfair Display, Inter, Space Grotesk, Fredoka, Nunito, Sora, and IBM Plex Sans.
All seven are also SIL Open Font License 1.1, all from https://github.com/google/fonts
(ofl/playfairdisplay, ofl/inter, ofl/spacegrotesk, ofl/fredoka, ofl/nunito, ofl/sora,
ofl/ibmplexsans). Same static-weight, Latin-subset treatment as above.
